images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / outpainting. Deliver ONE 1536x1024 PNG. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its leftmost 256 columns exactly, including every painted forest pixel and every pure green pixel. Replace ONLY the mid-grey placeholder at x=256..1535 with a seamless continuation. Image 2 is supporting STYLE and story reference only; do not copy its layout or include its sky, sun, ruins or cliffs. This is the upper-right panel of a 3x2 overlapping grid forming one continuous CHARRED FOREST VALLEY parallax layer. Continue the existing ridge and tree silhouettes naturally from the left strip across the right area, with flat pure #00ff00 everywhere above the silhouette. The silhouette's global position is 25–32 percent of the full layer height; this panel must inherit the left strip's actual contour and gently continue that contour, not reposition it. Green is perfectly flat RGB(0,255,0), no gradients, clouds, smoke, glow or objects above the ridge. Below the ridge fill all the way to the bottom with a vast burnt forest: very dark cool skeletal trunks and branches, grey violet ash ground, small orange ember pockets and lingering fires, curling smoke within the forest, winding water reflecting sunset. Continue the river, ground planes, smoke, trees and fires crossing x=256 without a visible join; keep matching scale and detail density near the seam. Denser darker forest toward the bottom. Hand-drawn painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game: confident hand-drawn dark contours with visible taper and varied weight, lighter thinner contours in distance, clean painted material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, rich environmental detail and local orange light spill. Cool low-value ambient with readable shadows, upper-left key, warm accents in embers/fire and river reflections as established in the strip. Elevated three-quarter environmental view. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border, vignette, cliff rim, architecture or separate sky. Preserve the entire original left 256-pixel strip unchanged; do not resize, reinterpret or repaint it. Remove every grey placeholder pixel with the appropriate green or forest continuation.
